scope: Rerun of local.read_contracts.20261102 with three new features: scripts/qualify_read_contracts.py on a frozen Debug build of 01b8c0f3 (artifacts/nc3, git archive), 187/187 steps in owned scratch projects; identity, typed refusal and completeness per feature for 37 read features. New: block_export (FB/FC/OB and DB selections equal to software_inspect, each native XML with its indexed size and block name, text files, namePrefix, maxBlocks paging with nextOffset, ProjectNotFound), plc_io_map (ranges and tags equal to an oracle from hardware_inspect and software_inspect on two DI 16x24VDC HF, a range without tags, two tags without listed hardware, PlcNotFound, AmbiguousTarget and complete=false with two PLCs) and plc_tag_usage over the block_export index (readers and writers of each I/Q tag from two SCL functions, a one-block index, unusedOnly, PlcNotFound). isModified was equal before and after the I/O analysis reads. Two earlier attempts on this day stopped on runner defects and are kept beside the run (rc_b19aaea1: the shared harness read a journal the summary result no longer carries; rc_71068bac: the runner expected the absolute operand to stay absolute).
limitations: One owned scratch project: CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with one software unit, plus CPU 1518-4 PN/DP added by hardware_add, and one VCI workspace (outside the project) mapping the SCL blocks RcCaller and RcFb by export; no safety, technology objects, HMI, connections, PLC documents or know-how protection, so those content families are observed only as empty, complete results.

Truncation is shown with maxItems/pageSize 1 (vci_workspace_inspect: 2) where the fixture has more rows; connection_inspect and plc_document_inventory have no rows to truncate here, and library_compare has a fixed 200-row bound that this fixture does not reach.
contentSha256 is checked as distinct, stable and content-tracking; it is not recomputed independently, because no other tool exports a block without document info.

A refused cpuTypeIdentifier is reported after the scratch project was created, because Siemens needs an open project for catalog access; the partial project is named in the refusal and its Portal is discarded.
plc_loadable_generate is positive only on the CPU 1518; on the CPU 1511 it is refused (UnsupportedCapability), as Siemens documents loadables only for CPU 1518 and its subtypes from firmware V2.8.

I/O analysis: two central DI 16x24VDC HF V1.0 (one tagged, one untagged), three Bool tags in table RcIo (one on the module, an output and an input without hardware) and two SCL functions; no output module, distributed I/O, drive telegram, shared address, LAD/FBD/STL network, protected block or paged index. The block_export index carries a size but no hash per file, so each XML is checked by size and by the block name it holds, each text file as present and non-empty. plc_tag_usage's untyped refusal of an index outside the artifact directory is not exercised.
Engineering reads only; no runtime, online or physical-device observation.

plc_tag_usage reported no absolute access: V21 replaced the absolute SCL operand %I0.1 with a tag it created at that address (Tag_...), which plc_io_map listed and plc_tag_usage reported with its reader. An absolute access was not produced natively; that branch has offline coverage only.
